title: SCHC core types: errors, config traits, const generics
description:
src/lib.rs and src/error.rs:
- BufferTooSmall, TooShort error types (4 lines each)
- SchcError enum aggregating all error variants
- Config trait or const generic bounds for M (window bits), N (FCN bits), T (DTAG bits), TILE_SIZE
- No runtime parameter branching - all compile-time
